p256Validator.note: Recompiling this source at this commit with this profile reproduces the creation code of the module's own Ethereum Sepolia deployment byte for byte, so expectedAddress and runtimeCodeHash both derive offline from deploymentInput alone. Two profile facts are load-bearing because they enter the contract metadata and therefore the address: the foundry profile configures evm_version osaka, which solc 0.8.26 does not know and compiles as cancun, and forge-std must resolve at lib/forge-std so its remapping appears in the metadata settings.

deploymentEvidence.note: The module's own broadcast record carries this exact deploymentInput and a status-1 receipt at this address. The constructor probes the P-256 precompile and reverts when it is absent, so the receipt is also evidence that Ethereum Sepolia carried EIP-7951 at this block. Read from the repository's committed broadcast record; no live RPC call was made.

ecdsaSigner.note: Exact zero-salt CREATE2 payload extracted from the verified Arbitrum Sepolia deployment transaction; Blockscout verification reproduces both creation and runtime bytecode.

p256Verifier.note: Not an ERC-7579 module: the audited Daimo P-256 verifier singleton the pinned WebAuthnSigner staticcalls at this fixed address when usePrecompiled is false. The deployment input is the exact mainnet broadcast calldata (zero salt + initcode) through the same deterministic CREATE2 proxy, so the address is chain-independent.

callPolicy.note: Recompiling this source with this profile and the mirrored Kernel v3 dependency sources reproduces the package's own cannon expected address, so the pinned address is ZeroDev's.

relatedVerifiedDeployment.note: One manual eth_getCode on 2026-08-04 read 4620 bytes of live code there; the pinned 0.0.4 runtime is 6539 bytes. 0.0.1 predates the explicit no-matching-permission revert, the ONE_OF condition, multi-parameter rules and the empty-calldata selector derivation a plain value transfer needs. Tests never read this address.

rateLimitPolicy.note: Recompiling this source with this profile and the package's own vendored Kernel v3 dependency sources reproduces the package's own cannon expected address, so the pinned address is ZeroDev's. onInstall reads id followed by packed uint48 interval, count and startAt; checkUserOpPolicy decrements count per validated operation and returns 1, Kernel's signature-failure sentinel, once it is exhausted.

kernelSource.note: Compiled from Kernel PR #152. Runtime hashes reproduced on local Anvil; no public deployment evidence is claimed.
